description: Tracked source of the privileged host execution environment: the scripts that establish and drive the sandbox from outside it. These are repository-tracked SOURCE FILES ONLY. This manifest does not describe, install, execute, or qualify a live running service; see README.md for the tracked-source-versus-installed-runtime boundary.

files.role: privileged host bootstrapper / legacy watch-or-one-shot runner

digest_note: sha256 computed via `shasum -a 256 <path>` against the exact committed blob content at the substantive commit of Task 0038-24. Any future content change to a listed file must update its digest here in the same commit; a stale digest is a manifest-verification defect, not a tolerated drift.
capability_boundary: These files are host-only executables. They are never executed by a sandboxed/grunt agent and never run inside the runner sandbox (SANDBOX.md). Ordinary sandboxed Task validation performs only static checks (automation_safety.py scanning, py_compile/syntax checks where applicable, manifest/digest verification) against this package; it never invokes run-loop.sh, perplexity-cpu-loop.js, perplexity-echo.as, or perplexity-loop.applescript as a live process. That exclusion is enforced by capability class (a sandboxed/grunt agent cannot execute shell/osascript at all, per SANDBOX.md) and by validation profile scope, not by hiding this package from static scanning or from the repository tree.
no_claims: This manifest makes no execution, service-activation, external-resource-access, credential, or privileged-qualification claim. It does not assert that any listed file currently runs anywhere, only that it is the current tracked source at the given digest.
